P1_skip.rule: skip session when any cell matches (state knowable at 09:45)

P2_size_tiers.rule: 2x S_1_1_3 block in listed cells, 1x elsewhere
P2_size_tiers.mechanism: date-list split, one replay per tier (2x = 2/2/6, entry 10)

P3_no_runner.rule: use 1/1/0 (no runner) when P(2R|1R) in state trails pooled by >=5pts
P3_no_runner.mechanism: date-list split, no-runner tier replay (1/1/0, entry 2)

P4_early_cut.rule: flatten at OR re-entry when it fires within the empirical cutoff before 1R
P4_early_cut.mechanism: requires small v2b_scaleout config flag (not replayed here)

P8_runner_ladder.rule: runner to 3R when chain>=0.30; no runner when chain<0.18; else baseline 1/1/3
P8_runner_ladder.mechanism: date-list tiers + runner_target_r_mult=3.0 on runner_3r tier

P9_reverse_only_when.rule: suppress reverse leg outside q1-morning edge states
